newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to publish rules for CVRD sale Friday - BNDES.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to publish rules for CVRD sale Friday - BNDES.

text.p: Brazil's government will publish the rules for the privatization auction of mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) on Friday, said an offial at the National Development Bank (BNDES).
The rules were due to be published last week, but the BNDES official said it took more time than expected to check over the lengthy document.
It will contain all the details of the auction except the minimum price, which will be divulged only 60 days before the sale.
CVRD's privatization auction is scheduled to take place in mid-February 1997.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
